test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
1. X is the father of Y and Z.

2. P is the mother of Q.

3. Q is the sister of Y.

So what is the relationship between X and P?

options.text: X and P are husband and wife.
X and P are father - daughter.

solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/787e52a1ad546ea4085b253573647acdf71f9028dc2f1a569f19eb8803e44bc1.png] 

The family tree can be drawn as per the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a16be8ff65b19568825147fbbb51f92b03ea64be2a9100c30856b7ec6ec3ebb.png] 

Here, we can see that X and P are husband and wife.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
